import FreeCAD, Part, os, Mesh
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Bracket")
ss = doc.addObject("Spreadsheet::Sheet","Params")
ss.set("A1","Width"); ss.set("B1","80"); ss.setAlias("B1","Width")
doc.recompute()
base = doc.addObject("Part::Box","BasePlate")
base.Width=60; base.Height=4; base.setExpression("Length","Params.Width")
back = doc.addObject("Part::Box","BackPlate")
back.Width=4; back.Height=50; back.setExpression("Length","Params.Width")
fuse = doc.addObject("Part::Fuse","Bracket"); fuse.Base=base; fuse.Tool=back
holes=[]
for i,s in enumerate(("-","+")):
    c = doc.addObject("Part::Cylinder","Hole%d"%(i+1))
    c.Radius=2.5; c.Height=6
    c.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0,-1,35), FreeCAD.Rotation(FreeCAD.Vector(1,0,0),-90))
    c.setExpression("Placement.Base.x","Params.Width / 2 %s 20 mm"%s)
    holes.append(c)
hf = doc.addObject("Part::MultiFuse","Holes"); hf.Shapes=holes
cut = doc.addObject("Part::Cut","WallBracket"); cut.Base=fuse; cut.Tool=hf
doc.recompute()
os.makedirs("/lab/out", exist_ok=True)
def export(tag):
    s=cut.Shape; bb=s.BoundBox
    print(tag,"valid",s.isValid(),"vol",round(s.Volume,2),"BB",bb.XMin,bb.YMin,bb.ZMin,bb.XMax,bb.YMax,bb.ZMax)
    for ext in ("step","stl"):
        p="/lab/out/bracket-%s.%s"%(tag,ext)
        try:
            if ext=="step": Part.export([cut],p)
            else: Mesh.export([cut],p)
            print("ok",p,os.path.getsize(p))
        except Exception as e: print("FAIL",p,e)
export("80")
ss.set("B1","100"); doc.recompute()
export("100")
print([ (h.Label,h.Placement.Base.x) for h in holes])
